description: The opened The Point report says the Gambia Teachers Union ended its sit-down strike after dialogue and that agreements were signed January 8. Search-only Foroyaa, Alkamba Times and Outpost 220 leads mention continuation, a January 8 dispatch or low-wage demands; Kerr Fatou, The Voice Gambia and a GNA header describe agreement/call-off or a government reaction around January 9–17. The reports’ sequence, publication times, direct state-response link and physical episode remain unverified. None of these records establishes strike sites, site-level attendance or a qualifying public assembly.
required_followup: When body access permits, inspect the full contemporary reports and seek union, school or government records that order the negotiation, agreement, continuation, call-off and actual return to work; distinguish work stoppage from public assembly and verify physical locations, attendance and start/end dates.

required_followup: Seek contemporaneous reporting or union/transport records establishing actual compliance, any public assembly and site-level attendance, direct state response, and the physical or operational end of the action.

None is assigned to January 2023 or coded as an event; year, occurrence, site-level attendance, physical dates, direct state response and written-origin relationships remain unresolved.

If a later coordinator-approved research stage identifies an eligible independent source, first establish publication/event dates and exact episode; for any January 2023 gathering, verify occurrence, physical site(s), at least 50 simultaneous attendees at each counted site, a state-directed policy demand, physical start/end, direct state response and source independence. Do not create candidates from titles or a planned rally.
